title: Sales quickstart screenshot comps and annotated asset set
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a cohesive set of annotated screenshot compositions and export-ready assets derived from Redwood Console product screenshots for the Sales/solutions quickstart deck. Deliverables should include desktop and tablet variants, light/dark theme screenshots where relevant, visual callouts (redactions for sensitive data), and Figma comps with annotation layers for copy and CTA guidance. Aim to surface product flows that matter for sales demos: onboarding flow, model selection and profiling, quick inference run, cost/latency breakdown, and rollout controls.
acceptance_criteria: All selected screenshots captured from the latest staging Console build (runtime-1.18 compatible) with production-like sample data
Figma file with separate pages for each deck slide and an annotations layer describing interaction/state
Exports in 2x and 3x PNGs for each screenshot and a 16:9 deck-ready composition exported as JPGs
Obvious PII removed or redacted and redaction notes included in asset metadata
Sign-off from PM (Lena Morales) and Sales Solutions lead (Owen Patel) recorded in comments
screenshot_inventory: Model Catalog - filter by hardware & verified profiles
Model Detail - perf profile and token cost estimate
Run Inference - streaming response and function call example
Observability - per-route latency & token cost breakdown
Rollouts - canary deploy UI and traffic split control
Private Deployment - VPC status and KMS key dropdown
image_specifications: Deck composition: 1920x1080 px JPG, sRGB, 80% quality
Primary screenshots: 1440x900 px PNG at 2x and 3x export
Annotations layer: vector text in Figma, do not rasterize
Redaction overlay: #111111 12% opacity with comment referencing source log id
tasks: Capture screenshots from staging with user: sales_demo@redwood.test
Create Figma comps for each deck slide and annotate copy/CTA
Apply redaction mask to customer-specific data and list redacted fields
Export asset packages (2x/3x + deck JPGs) and upload to Drive
Coordinate review with PM and Sales, incorporate feedback, finalize
